entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello? I'm calling about a return.
Hi there, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Charlie. I can definitely help you with that. Can I get your order number to start?
Sure, it's VF886-01. I bought a helmet a while back, but it's just been sitting here. The box is unopened and everything.
Okay, thank you. Let me pull that up... VF886-01. I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered about 55 days ago. What specifically is the issue with the item?
There's no issue, it's just not the right color for my new bike frame. It was a gift, and I just never got around to returning it.
I understand completely. Getting the right color is important. Let me just check our return policy for you... Okay, I see here that we have a 90-day return window for standard items.

Yes, so you are well within the timeframe. Since the box is unopened, this will be a very simple process. I've just approved the return in our system and a pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email on file. You'll receive a full refund once we receive the helmet.

That's great news, Charlie. Thank you. Now, since I'm going to be ordering another helmet from you, is there any chance you could provide a small discount code for the trouble of sending this one back?

I appreciate you asking, but our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on standard returns. However, the good news is you will be receiving a full refund for this item, and we can make sure you get the right gear. Your safety on the road is our top priority.
Alright, fair enough, I had to try. I'll get this sent back this week. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
